subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the prerequisite stack is finalized, should the temporary `@openclaw/qa-matrix` workspace package and lockfile importer be removed at the reconciled exact head in favor of sole QA Lab ownership?
rationale: This deliberately removes a package and plugin/runtime boundary, changes the dependency graph, and requires exact-head repository-admin or security authorization; automation cannot make that compatibility and ownership decision.

options.title: Approve Consolidated Ownership
options.body: Finalize the prerequisite, correct the scenario-count documentation, reconcile the branch, and authorize the exact-head package removal.

options.title: Retain The Temporary Package
options.body: Keep `qa-matrix` until maintainers want a separate compatibility or migration window, accepting continued duplicate ownership.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Leave this PR open until the prerequisite and package-boundary direction are stable enough for a fresh review.

recommendation.title: Approve Consolidated Ownership
recommendation.body: Finalize the prerequisite, correct the scenario-count documentation, reconcile the branch, and authorize the exact-head package removal.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository owner is needed for the exact-head dependency authorization and final ownership-boundary decision.
